bind_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port number the server listens on

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle requests

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS (requires valid TLS certificate and key)

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (used only if HTTPS is enabled)

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (used only if HTTPS is enabled)

docroot.description: Document root directory for serving static files

index_files.description: List of filenames to try when a directory is requested

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug logging (adds detailed request/response info)

level.description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn, error, critical

path.description: Path to the main log file

max_request_size.description: Maximum allowed HTTP request size in bytes (0 = no limit)

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed Origin hostnames for CORS (use '*' for all)

auth_file.description: Path to password file in htpasswd format (used only if auth is enabled)

rate_limit.description: Maximum requests per minute per client IP
